mcp_config.notes: MCP servers configurable; tool names follow mcp__<server>__<tool> pattern

detection_notes: Presence of CLAUDE.md in repo root or .claude/ folder
discovery_notes: Scans .claude/ folder and ~/.claude/ for skills and settings

tool_calls.name: Task
tool_calls.notes: Spawn sub-agent; supports isolation:worktree. New in 2.1.128: 'name' (addressable via SendMessage), 'team_name' (team context), 'mode' (acceptEdits|auto|bypassPermissions|default|dontAsk|plan), 'model' (sonnet|opus|haiku) override.

tool_calls.name: Bash
tool_calls.notes: Execute shell command; max timeout 600000ms; supports run_in_background

tool_calls.name: Read
tool_calls.notes: Read file; supports text, image, notebook, pdf types

tool_calls.name: enter_worktree
tool_calls.notes: Enter a git worktree for isolation

tool_calls.name: MultiEdit
tool_calls.notes: Apply multiple edits to a single file atomically

tool_calls.name: BashOutput
tool_calls.notes: Retrieve output of a background bash shell

tool_calls.name: Tmux
tool_calls.notes: Run commands in a tmux session

tool_calls.name: ReadMcpResourceTool
tool_calls.notes: Read an MCP resource (canonical internal name)

tool_calls.name: ReadMcpResourceDirTool
tool_calls.notes: Read an MCP resource directory listing

tool_calls.name: ListMcpResourcesTool
tool_calls.notes: List available MCP resources (canonical internal name)

tool_calls.name: Workflow
tool_calls.notes: Define or invoke a multi-step workflow

tool_calls.name: SendMessage
tool_calls.notes: Send a message to a named sub-agent or team member

tool_calls.name: SendUserMessage
tool_calls.notes: Send a message directly to the user

tool_calls.name: SendFile
tool_calls.notes: Send a file as an attachment

tool_calls.name: SendUserFile
tool_calls.notes: Send a file to the user

tool_calls.name: ReportFindings
tool_calls.notes: Report findings from an observer/analysis pass

tool_calls.name: propose_skills
tool_calls.notes: Propose new skills based on session context

tool_calls.name: RefreshMcpTools
tool_calls.notes: Refresh the list of available MCP tools

tool_calls.name: ListPeers
tool_calls.notes: List peer agents in a team

tool_calls.name: TaskGet
tool_calls.notes: Get details of a tracked task

tool_calls.name: self_hosted_runner_spawn_local
tool_calls.notes: Spawn a session on a self-hosted runner (enterprise feature); sibling tools observed: self_hosted_runner_requeue_session, self_hosted_runner_tail_log, self_hosted_runner_list_sessions, self_hosted_runner_list_runners, self_hosted_runner_get_pool, self_hosted_runner_list_secrets, self_hosted_runner_read_health, self_hosted_runner_read_metrics

tool_calls.name: mcp__claude-code-remote
tool_calls.notes: Built-in remote MCP server namespace; also observed extensive mcp__github__* first-party GitHub MCP tool catalog (~140 tools: pull_request/issue/workflow/gist/discussion read+write, code/repo search, notifications, releases) bundled directly into the claude CLI binary.

detection_notes: Presence of AGENTS.md in repo root
discovery_notes: Loads marketplace.json from plugin root for plugin metadata
rule_notes: Homepage and repository must be valid URLs

tool_calls.name: read_file
tool_calls.notes: Read file contents (internal editor tool constant)

tool_calls.name: str_replace_editor
tool_calls.notes: String-replace based file editing tool; supports view/create/str_replace/edit commands

tool_calls.name: view
tool_calls.notes: View file or directory contents (str_replace_editor command)

tool_calls.name: file_search
tool_calls.notes: Search for files by name/path pattern

tool_calls.name: grep_search
tool_calls.notes: Regex-based content search (internal editor tool constant, distinct from MCP 'grep')
